editorial.blurb: This playful rotary sushi bar serves impressively fresh fish at reasonable prices, with the bonus of a fun conveyer system and toy truck delivery that makes the whole experience feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive before 6pm on weekdays to avoid longer waits—no reservations accepted, but the fast-moving conveyer means you'll eat quickly once seated; order anything custom via the tablet if the rotating selection doesn't call to you.
